अरे भाई! बॉलीवुड के महंगे नखरे और एंट्रॉलेज कॉस्ट पर छिड़ गई है तगड़ी बहस! 🎬

अनुभवी फिल्ममेकर केसी बोकाड़िया ने ANI से बातचीत में अमिताभ बच्चन, शाहरुख खान, सलमान खान और रजनीकांत की जमकर तारीफ की है।
केसी बोकाड़िया का दावा है कि इन सुपरस्टार्स ने कभी प्रोड्यूसर्स को अपने स्टाफ की सैलरी नहीं देने दी और पूरी ग्रेस दिखाई।
मेकर का कहना है कि आज के कलाकार 4 से 10 वैनिटी वैन मांगते हैं और अपने स्टाफ का खर्च भी प्रोड्यूसर पर डालते हैं।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, चाय बनाने वाले और मैनेजर तक 1.5 लाख रुपये रोज चार्ज कर रहे हैं और कोई भी 50,000 रुपये से कम नहीं ले रहा है।
बोकाड़िया ने एक्टर्स से अपील की है कि वे प्रोड्यूसर्स पर थोड़ी दया करें वरना ऐसा दिन आ जाएगा जब अर्थी उठाने के लिए भी चार लोग किराए पर लाने पड़ेंगे।
क्या आज के स्टार्स को अपने खर्च कम करने चाहिए? 💸

ctx.title: Amitabh Bachchan, Salman Khan, Shah Rukh never made producers pay their staff, says KC Bokadia, asks actors to 'have mercy' with entourage costs
ctx.summary: Filmmaker KC Bokadia praised Amitabh Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan and Rajinikanth for not asking producers to pay their staff’s salaries.
ctx.text:
The debate around the high entourage costs of actors and their impact on film budgets has been gaining momentum in the industry. Recently, in a conversation with ANI, veteran filmmaker KC Bokadia praised Amitabh Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan , Salman Khan and Rajinikanth for their professionalism, saying they never asked producers to pay their staff's salaries. He also urged actors to show some consideration towards producers and have mercy on them when it comes to entourage costs.
The veteran filmmaker spoke about the changing dynamics on film sets and shared an anecdote about Jackie Shroff's approach to working arrangements during a shoot in Chennai (then Madras). He recalled how he once intervened after noticing that the actor had been provided with a double room instead of a suite. However, Jackie was not concerned about it at all.
He then highlighted how actors today demand four to 10 vanity vans and urged them to pay their staff themselves. He said, "Amitabh Bachchan never took the salary of his staff. Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Rajinikanth, all of them... They never made producers pay their staff. Atleast reach their level and show their level of grace."
He pointed out that actors today expect producers to bear the expenses of their personal staff and often demand four vanity vans for different purposes. The veteran filmmaker also spoke about the hefty salaries charged by crew members, calling the figures shocking.
He said, “We have heard that even someone who just makes tea and a manager charge ₹ 1.5 lakh a day. People charge ₹ 1–2 lakh for a day's shoot. Nobody charges less than ₹ 50,000 these days. They say they don't want a two-door van; they want a gym-equipped van. We tell them, please have some mercy on the producer, or a day may come when we will have to hire even four people to carry the body on their shoulders.”
KC Bokadia is known for directing and producing several Hindi films across the 1980s, 1990s and 2000s. He has worked with some of the biggest names in the industry, including Amitabh Bachchan, Dharmendra, Rajinikanth and Jeetendra. His notable directorial ventures include Aaj Ka Arjun, Phool Bane Angaray, Tyagi, Insaniyat Ke Devta, Shaktiman, Khuda Kasam, Lal Baadshah and Hum Tumhare Hain Sanam, among others.
